snapshot.intro_summary: 本章由123乘45的明確請求、驗證、執行、返回與完成證據開始，再討論自然語言下直接回答、呼叫或求助的策略與成本；這是路線導覽，不能把手寫格式等同已習得能力。

hand_calculation.pair_families: 10*11/2=55 unordered pairs with repetition; plus 10 COPY families =65

gpu_report_environment.timing_scope: experiment training, evaluation and local checkpoint saves; excludes image build, startup and HF uploads
gpu_report_environment.peak_memory_scope: Main-process PyTorch CUDA allocator allocated-byte peak since its most recent reset. Branch measurements can reset this counter; this is not necessarily the full-experiment peak. It excludes subprocesses, reserved-but-unused allocator memory and CUDA driver memory. Use branch-specific memory measurements and their scopes for comparisons.

weight_inspection.limitations: Public inference export omits source optimizer/RNG and training step; source checkpoint bytes are not independently inspected.

cpu_replay.scope: CPU inference from hash-pinned public export, no GPU speed/memory verification and no full retraining.

command_smoke.scope: One CPU optimizer update and actual controller generation; not the 1200-step GPU result.

assertions: All listed assertions passed; full 1200-step training was not run.
